replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
I like the map, don't get me wrong, but I feel as if there's way too much void and the main balloon isn't big enough. The smaller balloons don't seem to be able to hold much either...
Anyways, it's a good start, and not many maps call my attention nowadays, but I see a really strong potential in this one. Good job!
